studiesPage.title: Competitor Analysis
studiesPage.subtitle: Track what your competitors are doing, what it means for your business, and what to do about it. Separate from sentiment and opinion tracking, which answers what people are saying.
studiesPage.noMatchBody: Try adjusting your search, status, or date filters.
studiesPage.emptyBody: Start one and Strata will read your website to work out your market, find who you compete with, and report what they are doing about it.

onboarding.title: New competitor study
onboarding.subtitle: Name the companies this study tracks — import a list or add them one at a time — then decide which ones get a report. Documents are optional and can be added now or later; approving the articles split out of them is what gives a tracked competitor evidence to report on.

step1.heading: Add your competitors
step1.hint: Import the tracked-competitors list exported from the scraper app, or add companies by hand. You can add more of either later from the workspace.
step1.emptyBody: Import a list or add one above to get started.

step2.heading: Review & track
step2.hint: Only tracked competitors get a report. Untrack anything you added but don’t want to follow, or remove it outright.
step2.emptyBody: Go back and import a list or add one by hand.

step3.heading: Add documents
step3.hint: Articles extracted from each new document are automatically included and saved to the Articles page. Delete unwanted saved articles there before starting analysis. Pending candidates can be approved or rejected here. Approval saves articles; analysis starts explicitly.
step3.emptyBody: Add some above, or finish now and add them later from the workspace.

documentsPanel.dropzoneTitle: Drag files here, or click to browse

documentsPanel.emptyBodyWizard: Add some above, or finish now and add them later from the workspace.
